verdict.rationale: Data residency is a fair question for a cloud meeting-notes service, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents choosing a storage region or data residency. Related privacy controls (transcript auto-deletion, model-training opt-out, HIPAA for Enterprise) are adjacent features and do not deliver region selection.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
